303 · Position Management

How much capital and time does it deserve, and how do I leave?

Plan the exposure. Require evidence before adding. Realize gains, reassess, and preserve capital for the next decision.

Start chapter 1 →17 short chapters · examples + evidence

Do not marry the position. Marry the net return. Reassess your exposure as buyers, dev incentives, and executable conditions change.
